scope: Selected verified, non-overlapping recovery windows; coverage differs from without-group windows, so totals are not a between-group metric.

windows.basis: Pour selected stove rather than mug; retry on mug wall
Teaspoon selection recovery, including tray discovery/staging and second failed grasp

other_redundancy: Repeated successful navigation/opening and single-item trips remain cost candidates; no exact avoidable-action total established.
